newsitem.title: USA: Armstrong sues to block Sommer-Domco deal.
newsitem.headline: Armstrong sues to block Sommer-Domco deal.

text.p: Armstrong World Industries Inc., trying to bolster its bid for floor covering maker Domco Inc., said Wednesday it filed a second suit against Domco directors and the Canadian company's controlling French shareholder.
Armstrong on Monday offered to buy Domco for C$488 million ($352 million).

Lancaster, Pa.-based Armstrong said it filed suit in Ontario Court against the directors of Domco and against Sommer Allibert SA, the French company that controls Domco, charging it subordinated the rights of minority shareholders.

Armstrong, as a minority shareholder of Domco, wants the courts to declare that Domco directors have subordinated the company's and minority shareholders' interests to those of Sommer and have breached their duties to Domco and minority shareholders.
Armstrong is a global manufacturer and marketer of interior furnishings and ceiling systems as well as floor coverings. It had sales of $2.16 billion in 1996.

The suit follows a similar move on Monday when Armstrong filed a 10-count complaint in a U.S. District Court against Sommer Allibert to prevent it from merging its floor covering business, including Domco, with Tarkett AG, another floor covering manufacturer.
